statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-49835 (GHSA-9c54-x2g4-v92j) is an unbounded Prometheus metric label cardinality OOM in the timestamp-authority HTTP server's wrapMetrics middleware, defined in pkg/generated/restapi/configure_timestamp_server.go, which is only linked in when running the timestamp-authority server binary (cmd/timestamp-authority). kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/timestamp-authority code directly; it is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain, which only imports the client-side github.com/sigstore/timestamp-authority/pkg/verification package to verify RFC 3161 timestamp responses. That package does not import pkg/generated/restapi or pkg/server, so the vulnerable middleware is not compiled into the reports-server binary and reports-server never runs a timestamp-authority HTTP server.
